release_notes:
Fix: same duplicate-settlement false positive in Wise reconcile

wise_reconcile.php's amount-only fallback pass had the identical blind spot
just fixed in zelle_reconcile.php: gf_payment_user_recently_settled() blocks
crediting a pending invoice whenever the same user already has another settled
invoice at the same amount/currency/method nearby, with no way to tell a
genuine repeat payment apart from the same deposit being misattributed twice.

Reuses the gf_zelle_distinct_settlement() override added for Zelle (logic is
payment-method-agnostic -- it just compares TransactionId references) at
Wise's one equivalent call site.
